The '''Talravin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the planet [[Talravin]].<ref name="KotOR" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Core Worlds map of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' shows the Talravin system along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] while the [[Jedi Civil War]] maps displays the Talravin system at another location, along the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]].<ref name="TEA" />
